subject: SOC 2 Type II: initial intake, audit period & bridge-letter options
messages:
From: Taylor Reed <taylor.reed@finco.com>

Cc: ask@auditops-llc.com
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 Type II — initial request and audit window

Hi Sean,

We’re kicking off our diligence for the upcoming supplier review and need to request Redwood’s SOC 2 Type II package and supporting artifacts. Our audit calendar has a procurement cutoff of 2027-02-25, so if possible we’d like to receive materials by then.

High-level asks:
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) covering the most recent 12-month period.
- Bridge letter or attestation if the report’s end date misses our required window.
- Control coverage matrix (which controls map to which Trust Service Criteria).
- Evidence manifest (sample logs, config snapshots, access control screenshots).
- Preferred secure transfer: presigned S3 links or SFTP — let us know what works.

Attached is a short request template we use to capture what to expect (FinCo_Soc2_Request_Form_v1.xlsx). Our auditor (AuditOps LLC) is CC’d and will intake the files.

Questions for you:
1) What is Redwood’s most recent Type II audit period (start/end)?
2) If the report end date is outside our window, can you provide a bridge letter and a minimal evidence sampler by the cutoff?
3) Any redaction policies we should be aware of before download?

Thanks — a quick reply with dates and transfer options would be great.

Best,
Taylor
Taylor Reed
Head of Vendor Risk, FinCo

From: sean_gallagher@redwood.com

Hi Taylor — thanks for the clear note and the template. Quick answers up front:

1) Latest Type II period: 2026-09-01 to 2027-02-28. Our final report PDF is available and covers that window.
2) Bridge letter: we can provide a bridge letter that covers the gap if you need coverage beyond 2027-02-28; we typically issue a bridge that states no material control changes since the report end date and list interim compensating controls.
3) Redactions: we can provide a near-complete package with minimal redaction for customer-identifying data. Standard redactions include customer names in screenshots and internal usernames. We will not redact control descriptions or audit firm conclusions.

What we can deliver by your 2027-02-25 cutoff (assuming turnaround from our side and your intake):
- SOC 2 Type II PDF (report) — will be ready within 24 hours of confirmation.
- Bridge letter (if requested) — draft in 48 hours, signed in 72 hours.
- Control coverage matrix (CSV) — includes mapping to TSC and sample artifact references.
- Evidence manifest (CSV) — pointers to sample logs/configs and suggested redactions.

Transfer options: presigned S3 links are fastest; we can also SFTP. For presigned links we’ll provide an expiry window (typical 7 days).

I’m attaching our standard response/template that contains a recommended evidence manifest format and example one-line replies you can paste into your intake system.

Action items:
- Please confirm acceptance of presigned S3 or request SFTP and which contact AuditOps will use to fetch files.
- Confirm whether you want a bridge letter issued immediately or only if the report end date is insufficient after your internal review.

One-line templates (examples you can forward to stakeholders):
- "We will deliver Redwood’s SOC 2 Type II report (2026-09-01 to 2027-02-28) and an evidence manifest via presigned S3 links by 02/25/2027."
- "Redwood will provide a bridge letter if report coverage is insufficient for FinCo’s audit window."

If helpful I’ll loop in Marissa to coordinate the secure transfer and evidence manifest export.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
